info.name: Member ID Resolution Service
info.description: Every scenario of POST /api/v1/member-ids/resolve against the local profile (in-process MMI stub on port 9090). Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner; each request carries its own tests.

exec: pm.test(".coverage.active = True", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(j.coverage.active)).to.eql(JSON.stringify(true)); });
pm.test(".company = THP", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(j.company)).to.eql(JSON.stringify("THP")); });

pm.test("no PHI leaks", function () { const b = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(b).to.not.include("memberFirstName"); pm.expect(b).to.not.include("socialSecurityNumber"); pm.expect(b).to.not.include("memberDob"); });
